name: Exa Search API
description: Exa AI search API — neural and keyword web search, page content retrieval, similarity search, and LLM-grounded answers. Core endpoints: POST /search (find pages by meaning or keyword), POST /contents (cleaned page text, highlights, summaries), POST /findSimilar (semantically similar pages), POST /answer (a sourced answer to a question), POST /context (code snippets from open-source repos), and POST /responses and POST /chat/completions (OpenAI-compatible surfaces). The Agent API — POST /agent/runs then GET /agent/runs/{id} — runs long multi-step research and is the replacement for the retired Research API. Monitors (/monitors) schedule recurring searches, and Websets (/websets/v0/*) build verified, enriched result sets. On /search the `type` parameter is the primary quality/latency/cost dial: instant, fast, auto, deep-lite, deep, deep-reasoning (deep-reasoning takes 12-40s and replaces the old research runs). Note that not everything is POST — Websets, Monitors, and Agent runs use GET/PATCH/DELETE as well. Auth is handled automatically via the EXA_API_KEY environment variable, injected as the x-api-key header.
